build_GetBBoxCenterScale: build a transform that converts bounding boxes from xyxy format to center and scale with configurable padding
build_RandomFlip: build a transform that randomly flips images, bboxes, and keypoints horizontally, vertically, or diagonally
build_RandomHalfBody: build a transform that randomly selects upper or lower body keypoints and adjusts the bounding box accordingly
build_RandomBBoxTransform: build a transform that randomly shifts, resizes, and rotates bounding boxes using truncated normal distributions
build_GenerateTarget: build a transform that encodes keypoints into heatmap or regression targets using configurable codec encoders
